title: Knowledge Citation and Evidence Locator
description: Structured citation binding model answers to governed ACTIVE knowledge corpus documents, versions, and source locators.

documentId.description: Canonical document ID matching the governed knowledge corpus registry (e.g. ISSN-PROTEIN-EXERCISE-2017-VI-01, WHO-PA-SB-2020-VI-03).

version.description: Semantic version of the cited knowledge document (e.g. 1.0.0 for snapshot, 1.1.0 for derivative).

sourceId.description: Source package identifier (e.g. ISSN-PROTEIN-EXERCISE-2017, WHO-PA-SB-2020, NIDDK-WEIGHT-FACTORS-2023, NIH-ODS-EXERCISE-SUPPLEMENTS).

sourcePath.description: Relative source path of the cited content within the corpus (e.g. data/knowledge/curated/issn-protein-2017/01-scope.vi.md).

heading.description: Optional section heading within the source document.

pageRange.description: Optional 1-based [startPage, endPage] range in the source PDF asset.

quoteOrExcerpt.description: Optional brief verbatim excerpt from the source text supporting the claim.
